record.question: Eri Silk Development Project in Mizoram under Silk Samagra – 2 is launched by __________, Member Secretary, CSB on 14.06.2022.
record.explanation: This is a specific current-affairs fact from June 2022. Shri J.C. Deka served as Member Secretary, Central Silk Board (CSB) around that period and was associated with launching Silk Samagra-2 projects in Northeastern states. However, without access to the official press release or Mizoram Sericulture Department records for 14.06.2022, this cannot be verified definitively. The other names (Rahmahtulla, Moncy Issac, RR Okhandiar) are also plausible CSB/state officials.
